name: pipe_file_operations

ownership.argument: NuttX pipe file-operations table that a pipe inode stores at inode+16. Astrolink compares the inode's operations pointer against this table to prove that the two files it pinned in the default loop's owning filelist are that loop's pipe, before it writes a wake byte to them. Read-only identity; it is never called.

provenance.source: nx_pipe at 0xc8cd8d8 passes this table to register_inode (0xc914e7c); the table's ten words are the same pipe handlers as .155 (0xc32e0e9 open, 0xc32e019 close, 0xc32cddd read, 0xc32ce9d write, 0xc328955 ioctl), only its address carries the +0x10 shift seen across this image.

notes: Address catalogue only; the table is compared, never called.
